progress.message: Claude Code is designing the animation

request: Skullflinger: Throws skulls of fallen enemies. Gleeful and twitchy. His attack (Skull_Throw) is already made and approved. He holds a skull mace in his right hand; keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Idle
animations.description: Tosses a skull up a little and catches it in the same hand, looks around eagerly for a target, cackles (shoulders shaking). Loops.

animations.name: OH_Walk
animations.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: bouncy, eager skip-walk, skull held up by his shoulder.
